reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount (which itself uses getRangeAmount) instead of re-deriving the range rule.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the rule lives only in the shared schedules helper.

placement.why: Field added in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity, the API mapping layer.

scope.why: Minimal change plus a release note, as the repo convention expects.

maintainability.why: Clear, documents the field as read-only and keeps the rule in one place.
